title: Interpolation of orientable total domination by safe arc reversals: a proof of the Hansen-Lai-Yue conjecture (JCMCC 1999; Anderson-Dravec-Johnston-Kuenzel Conjecture 3.1, arXiv:2311.16307)

exact_endpoint: OrientableTotalDomination.conjecture_true : OrientableTotalDomination.Conjecture, where Conjecture := for every finite vertex type V and Boolean adjacency G with nonempty spectrum and every c with lower G <= c <= upper G, c is in spectrum G; spectrum G is the set of minimum total-dominating-set sizes over valid (positive indegree) orientations of G, with total domination by in-neighbours
scope: The full conjecture for all finite graphs admitting a valid orientation: every integer between dom_t(G) and DOM_t(G) is the total domination number of a valid orientation.

substantive_reason: It settles, for all finite graphs, a conjecture posed in 1999 and restated as open in 2023/2026, where only complete and complete bipartite graphs were known. The new ingredient is a blocked-flip transfer lemma (if every target-directed reversal is blocked by a unique in-arc, every total dominating set transfers to the target), which repairs the failure of single-arc continuity caused by the validity requirement. Significance is modest-to-substantive; the proof is short and elementary.
